entry.name: DeCAL dataset
entry.title: DeCAL: Towards Physically-Grounded Dexterous Vision-Language-Action Models via Contact-Aware Latent Co-Imagination
entry.summary: 1,279 teleoperated bimanual trajectories over 13 tasks on two UR5 arms with two 22-DoF Sharpa Wave hands, with a 6-D contact vector and a 240x240 deformation image for each of the 10 fingertips, front and two wrist RGB views, 56 joint positions and a per-frame language instruction at 30 Hz.
entry.hand: Sharpa Wave (22 DoF) x 2 on two UR5 arms

sensor.note: Per fingertip (10 per frame): a 6-D contact vector (10 x 6 per frame) and a 240x240x1 contact-deformation image (10 x 240 x 240 x 1). The paper derives 6-DoF force/torque from raw 320x240 tactile images with a pretrained regression model and deformation maps with a translation model (TacMap); the release carries the vector and deformation image, raw tactile images are not listed on the card.

scale.text: 1,279 trajectories, 1,989,891 frames at 30 Hz, 13 tasks (Open-X-Tactile release); the paper trains on 100 demonstrations for each of 6 tasks

entry.access: ModelScope Aureleo/DeCALdata_OXT (Open-X-Tactile Zarr, 2.0 TB, Apache License 2.0 on the card), linked from the DeCAL code repository README.
entry.license: Apache-2.0 (ModelScope card header; the card's notes say licensing stays with the original DeCAL release)
caveats: The release (13 tasks, 1,279 trajectories) is larger than the paper's training set (6 tasks: Wipe Vase, Erase Whiteboard, Assemble Parts, Twist Cap, Pipetting, Screw Light Bulb; 100 demonstrations each); the 7 extra task names were not read.

Only the Open-X-Tactile conversion was found. The code README's link to ModelScope Aureleo/DeCAL_dataset gave no card (its .md returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-23), so the original robot logs were not seen.
The card says the converted release provides state trajectories from which to derive future-state action targets; recorded teleoperation commands are not listed among the fields.
Teleoperation used MANUS MetaGlove Pro gloves and VIVE trackers (paper).

tracking.system: UR5 joint positions (6 per arm) and Sharpa Wave joint positions (22 per hand)
MANUS MetaGlove Pro with VIVE trackers
tracking.note: teleoperation interface named in the paper

unconfirmed: Camera roles: the card lists one front and two wrist RGB cameras; the paper lists two wrist and one egocentric RealSense D435. Resolution 640x480 is the card's stored shape.
hours not computed: 1,989,891 frames at 30 Hz would be about 18.4 h; the card gives no duration.
Availability 'public' from the ModelScope card (no gate stated, 234,411 downloads listed); the file listing renders with JavaScript and was not read. Files not opened.
scene_types 'lab' is inferred from the task names and project page videos; scenes are not labelled.
Venue: the project page and repository description say CoRL 2026; the arXiv record lists none.
